subject: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Hope youre well. Our renewal for the dedicated GPU pool is coming up in mid-November (contract ends 2028-11-15). We currently have a reserved pool of 80x L40s (12-month commit) and have been using burst capacity irregularly.

Were looking at two things ahead of renewal:
- Add a mixed-GPU tranche to handle lower-cost batching: ~16x T4 equivalent plus 8x L40s for peak.
- Mid-term uplift: ability to move 12 burst GPUs into reserved capacity now (start-of-Nov) and then scale an additional 12 GPUs at renewal.

Questions:
1) What pricing / discount would you offer for a mid-term amendment vs folding into the renewal?
2) Can you provide throughput guarantees (tokens/min) and a simple SLA credit model if burst performance degrades?
3) How does billing prorate for an uplift that starts mid-contract, and do we get roll-forward credits for unused committed hours?

Ive attached a short usage snapshot for Q3. If easier, happy to set a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Operations
Atlas AI
attachments: usage_snapshot_q3.csv
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry

Hi Samira,

Thanks for the clear note and for the Q3 snapshot. A few quick asks so we give you a clean set of options:
- Can you confirm p95/p99 latency targets and the common sequence lengths for your generative workloads? This drives kernel selection and effective throughput.
- Are the T4s proposed for offline batched inference (lower SLO) or for low-cost online inference (tight latency)?

Prelim thoughts:
- Mid-term amendment (start 2028-11-01): we can convert up to 12 burst GPUs into reserved commit today with a weighted proration and apply a 10-14% uplift discount off the on-demand list if you take a 9-12 month pro-rated commit.
- Renewal consolidation: folding the uplift into the 12-month renewal (starting 2028-11-15) unlocks better tier discounts (typically 16-20% on the added tranche).

If youre comfortable, Ill ask Ben to draft two price options (Amendment now vs. Renewal consolidate) with the expected SLA language and credit math.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasai.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry

Samira / Naomi,

I attached a proposed amendment (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf) with two commercial options. High level:

Option A 9-month commit for added tranche (24 GPUs mix: 8x L40, 16x T4)
- Effective discount on new tranche: 18% off list
- Throughput guidance: baseline 1.8M tokens/min for the full pool, p99 latency target 450ms
- SLA: 99.5% availability for inference; credits escalate to 10% of monthly committed spend for repeated miss (2+ quarters)
- Proration: month-of-start billed pro-rata, remaining months billed per committed schedule

Option B -month short top-up (3 months)
- Effective discount: 8% off list
- Flexible cancellation at end of 3 months or convert to reserved at renewal with applied credit for months used

Notes:
- If you need stronger throughput guarantees (e.g., 2M+ tokens/min sustained with tighter p99), we can price a higher SLA tier and add penalty credits.
- We can add a roll-forward credit clause for a portion of unused committed hours; typically we offer 10-25% roll-forward depending on term length.

Share feedback and Ill put a clean redline for legal/finance.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry

Thanks Ben / Naomi.

Were leaning to Option A (the 9-month commit for the 24-GPU mix) for predictability, provided we can get two clarifications before we move to legal:
1) Stronger throughput SLA: we need a 2.0M tokens/min floor across the combined pool during peak windows (08:00-20:00 PT) with p99 <= 350ms. If missed for 2 consecutive weeks in peak windows, wed expect a credit of 15% of that months committed spend.
2) Roll-forward credits: important. Wed like a clear schedule where up to 30% of unused committed hours in months 1-6 can be rolled forward into months 7-12.

Well also need to confirm how on-prem/private endpoints are routed (we use a VPC) and whether the added T4s can be isolated to a cheaper availability zone.

If you can confirm those two points Ill ask procurement to greenlight and sign.

Samira
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Oct 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: pool scale & mixed-GPU add-on inquiry

Samira / team,

Appreciate the clarity. Quick internal summary and commitments from Redwood:
- Throughput SLA: we can meet the 2.0M tokens/min peak floor with p99 <= 350ms, but that will move the tranche pricing to the SLA+ tier. That adjusts the new tranche discount to 14% (vs. 18% previously listed) to cover capacity and priority routing.
- Credit model: miss for 2 consecutive weeks in peak windows -> 15% credit of that months committed spend (matches your ask).
- Roll-forward: we can offer up to 30% roll-forward for months 1-6 with clear utilization reporting and one-time conversion window.
- Networking: T4 tranche can be pinned to a lower-cost AZ within your VPC; well require a short network runbook and service account mapping.

Next steps: Ben will send a redline reflecting SLA+ pricing, Ill open the amendment in HubSpot and route to finance/legal. Samira, I included the HubSpot deal and DocuSign pre-auth link below for expedited signing.

Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345
DocuSign (pre-auth): https://redwood.box.com/s/DocuSign-Atlas-Addendum-2028

Thanks all,
Priyom Das
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
